## Context

The two-clone enrichment regression added for bug 8185 uses `git merge-tree --write-tree`, available in Git 2.38 and newer. The repository does not currently declare that Git floor or skip the test clearly on older clients.

## Plan

- Determine the supported Git version floor for contributors and CI.
- Either document/enforce Git 2.38+ or add an explicit capability/version guard that skips with a clear reason on supported older clients.
- Verify the regression remains collected and executed on every gating CI environment.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The supported Git version floor is explicit and consistent across contributor docs and CI.
- [x] The merge-tree regression fails or skips with a clear diagnostic when the capability is unavailable.
- [x] Gating CI still executes the real two-clone merge-tree assertion.
